name: Rocaille Canted Octagon
historical_direction: French floral Rococo design study informed by documented early/mid Louis XV carving
front_material_label: Black frame / gray mat / white back
provenance: New octagon floral composition informed by The Met public-domain photograph of frame1971.206.34, design attributed to Meissonnier ca.1735, and Getty Louis XV frame documentation. No MakerWorld mesh used.
project_description: Historically grounded French floral Rococo miniature; uncut Instax Mini, modern supported relief, four rounded-root PLA clips and three concealed 6x3mm magnets.
project_provenance: Historical carving reference: The Metropolitan Museum of Art,1971.206.34, ca.1735, https://www.metmuseum.org/art/collection/search/209073 (public-domain photograph). New octagon composition, not a facsimile. Getty Louis Style guide also informed ornament. No MakerWorld mesh used.
brief: Genuinely eight-sided landscape silhouette with long horizontal and vertical rails and four equal diagonal clipped corners; eight-sided aperture. Diagonal corner lands part of continuous octagonal moulding. Unequal large floral/acanthus clusters bridge the clipped corners, long rails carry tapered scrolling stems and recessed grounds. A single broad low curled shell near the top, a smaller foliated curl beneath; no crown. Clearly an octagon, never an oval.
relief_method: Local articulation of existing folds and rolling-sphere roundover of selected petal/shell lips and exterior tips over depth/normal relief

Solid shoulder/spandrel areas hide the film corners. Balanced contour, no lopsided bulge.

Rounded rectangular aperture with four identical circular corner radii and near-straight sides. Two diagonal large blooms and two varied smaller floral groups grow from scrolling rails. Off-folded upper shell, lower foliated curl. Neither ellipse nor pointed diamond, no pillow with pasted flowers.

brief: Landscape rectangular inner architecture, corner-and-center composition. Four DIFFERENT flower-and-leaf groups: upper-left open broad bloom, upper-right turned irregular bloom, lower-right smaller open flower, lower-left folded leaf and bud. Petals extend enough to hide every circular mounting base. Linked tapering tendrils and textured recessed rail fields. Low modest shell at top, not tall crown. Busy detailed carving with clear hierarchy and rested stretches of rail, not equal repeated badges.
relief_method: Local articulation of existing folds and rolling-sphere roundover of selected petal/shell lips and exterior tips over depth/normal relief

brief: Landscape rectangular inner moulding with expressive diagonal floral movement: dominant open flower group upper left, different slightly smaller open/half-closed group lower right, a third modest bloom at upper right. Stems visibly continue along rails; opposite lower-left corner folded acanthus and buds. Modest off-center lower shell sustains diagonal flow. Rich varied foliage, no neoclassical ribbon swag, no repeated laurel rows, no identical corner rosettes.
relief_method: Explicit traced unequal petal bowls and curved overlap channels in CAD height geometry

brief: Landscape straight rectangular sight moulding with most exuberant carved architecture at compact footprint. Strong folded acanthus at corners supporting varied substantial flowers that grow from the scrolling stems. Broad rolled asymmetrical upper shell, smaller different lower shell/leaf response, scrolling leaves carried continuously across hollow rail. Dense busy yet hierarchical: high floral masses, medium folded C and S scrolls, low textured recessed grounds. No same top and bottom fan and no row of matching badges.
